adversarial_audit.objection: Small S6 conditional MI proves physical rank mixing.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False. The target is an average under the physical outer law, not one tuple.

adversarial_audit.objection: The largest-dimension partition is automatically typical enough.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Maximal dimension is only one Plancherel atom; typical-set averaging is still required.

adversarial_audit.objection: The observed n sequence supports monotone decay.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It does not: S5 conditional MI exceeds S4 before the sharp S6 drop.

falsifiers_triggered: Selected low-overlap blocks cannot substitute for complete coupling coverage.

proof_obligations.resolution: Every allowed block is contracted and both exact rank marginals close.
